name: Robert
source:
He's the mysterious man standing in yandere-chan street --not a stalker-- he's just loitering about --definitely not a stalker-- and occasionally tries to look through her window --most definitely not a stalker...
The binoculars he wears around his neck? It's for birdwatching of course!
